name: Tiajuana Food Court
blocked: multi-vendor food court: address confirmed (1655 Broadway, Chula Vista) but the listed site is a low-quality farm-style page (cheap .shop TLD, templated AI-written copy) describing 'five unique restaurants' under one roof (El Cacho Fish Tacos Stand, a sushi vendor, etc.), each with its own separate menu/site (elcachofishtacostand.com, tiajuanafc.com) and no single priced menu for the food court as a whole
notes: Yelp confirms it is a food court with multiple independent vendor menus; filing one vendor's menu under the food-court id would misattribute it. Not a single restaurant with one menu.

name: Jalisco Cafe
notes: Owner.com storefront; menu read from the Next.js RSC flight payload (menuGroup/menuItem objects), not the rendered HTML which only server-renders the first category. 148 dishes across 19 groups covering all core sections (tacos, burritos, enchiladas, sandwiches, breakfast, combinations, sides, desserts, beverages). Cent distribution is conventional printed-menu (.99 x75, .49 x25, .79 x21, .29 x7, etc.); divisor sweep 1.04-1.30 found no coherent uniform markup (best match 21/148), so no fee-inflation pattern. Site's own JSON-LD listed street number as 4026 Bonita Rd (vs batch's 4062); Google Maps and phone/reviewCount(691) confirm 4062 Bonita Rd is correct and this is the same restaurant - likely a typo in the platform's own listing.

name: Amalfi Marina Bar (Dockside)
notes: First-party PDF menu linked from the restaurant's own Marina Bar page (address 1035 La Bonita Dr, San Marcos 92078 confirmed on that page). Extracted via pdftotext -layout; food sections (appetizers, salads, entree, burgers/sandwiches, tacos, pizza, sides, kids meal, caffetteria, desserts) plus the Cocktails list were clean single-column reads. The Wines/Beers section is a 3-column layout that garbled name-to-price pairing on the page and was skipped rather than risk a mispaired price - genuine gap, not evidence of missing data. One pizza ('Saltimbocca') had no clear base price printed (only an add-on note) and was dropped per the no-invented-price rule.
